title: The Yahoo Office
brief: A scam crew on Lekka Strip has been emptying market women's accounts. The Task Force raids them tonight. Get in first and take the laptops.
standout: In and out of the crew's office before the door comes off its hinges.

objectives.text: Get to the office door unseen
objectives.sub: Crouch (X). Behind a lookout, E takes him down.

say.speaker: Lekka Strip, night
lines: Amaka: Third floor. Two lookouts wey think say dem be security.
Amaka: Iya Tobi's name dey their list. Mama's own money.

objectives.sub: Z when the marker is on it

objectives.late: The Task Force kicked the door in with you still inside.

onDone.toast: The laptops show the crew pays Shina 'protection'.

objectives.title: THE VICTIMS' MONEY
lines: The crew's accounts hold what they took from the market women.
Tunde can send it back to them, or you can keep a cut for the trouble.

options.text: Send it all back to the victims
options.toast: Iya Tobi's alert just came in.
